entry.name: jit.desktop
entry.digest: Copy the display into a matrix
entry.description: Grabs the contents of the computer display, taking a screen shot of whatever lies at the specified screen coordinates and placing that data into a Jitter matrix.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.description: Coordinates of the computer display to copy into a Jitter matrix. The display area is specified by four ints corresponding to the x and y pixel offsets from the upper left of the computer screen followed by the the x and y values offset from the upper left of the computer screen of the bottom right corner of the matrix (default = 0 0 320 240).
